payload.title: File:Australovenator2.jpg
payload.description_html:
Life restoration of Australovenator wintonensis scavenging from a carcass of Diamantinasaurus matildae.
  • Based on fig. 2 of Hocknull, Scott A.; White, Matt A.; Tischler, Travis R.; Cook, Alex G.; Calleja, Naomi D.; Sloan, Trish; and Elliott, David A. (2009). "New mid-Cretaceous (latest Albian) dinosaurs from Winton, Queensland, Australia". PLoS ONE 4 (7). doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0006190.
  • Head based on that of Neovenator salerii.
